Then no extract, no lake target and no Power BI data set appears in any schema, path or fake

  Scenario: AC9 The contract holds the business rules BR1 to BR9 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the contract documents of this story
    When they are reviewed against the business rules of section 8
    Then the only REST base is /api/recovery/source-data/v1 and no other service's path is declared
    Then event names are rwb.<short>.<Event>.v1 on rwb.<short>.events.v1, and this resource consumes one event and publishes none
    Then every event carries the CloudEvents 1.0 envelope and no personal data
    Then every POST declares the Idempotency-Key header and stores its response, and the rerun is the only POST this resource relies on
    Then error responses use one envelope and one message ID per condition, with the legacy texts unchanged
    Then a schema change within major version 1 is additive, and a breaking change is a new major version
    Then only operations owned by rwb-source-data are listed, and the case query, the parameters and the reference data are described as consumed
    Then the tolerance, the entry threshold and the waiting periods stay parameters and no business value is fixed in the contract
    Then no lake element exists, and the result is read and never extracted

Data-product reads of the same service (API Specification v5, `rwb-source-data.yaml`), referenced here and not part of the reconciliation resource: `GET /data-products/freshness` (query `product`, `asOf`; elements `productCode`, `productName`, `sourceSystem`, `businessDate`, `sourceExtractedAt`, `loadedAt`, `status`, `staleSince`) and `GET /data-products/{productCode}/records` (query `caseId`, `page`, `size`; page elements `items`, `freshness`, `page`, `size`, `total`; row elements `recordId`, `entity`, `fields`), both under `/api/recovery/source-data/v1`. Product codes (FSD P1 v3, data product table): DP01 Account and arrears, DP02 Customer and party, DP04 Treatment and offers, which holds the plan data read through `v_ace_plan`. The business date is the `businessDate` of the freshness read; the records read declares no business-date parameter. The plan side of REC-03 is read from the DP04 records, keyed by `plan_ref` (GAP-2235).
